ui.agentMessages.settings.default_on.e_b.verdict: PASS. Points to the consent text below and to turning it on again, and avoids each locale's Enable word (ui.agentMessages.settings.action.enable). ur uses فعال, which is its Settings 'on' word throughout this namespace (state.c_title فعال) and stays distinct from the Enable button label 'فعال کریں' by sentence context; acceptable.

ui.agentMessages.settings.action.turn_on.verdict: PASS. Renders 'turn on again'. In fr/es/ru/vi/ur/hi its bytes equal action.enable_again (Activer à nouveau, Volver a activar, Включить снова, Bật lần nữa, دوبارہ فعال کریں, फिर चालू करें), because those locales already used their plain on-verb for Enable; no distinct non-'Enable' verb exists there. The two keys never render together (default-on vs opt-in branches in agent-messages-settings.tsx), so there is no collision. zh-CN distinguishes 重新开启 from 重新启用. Recorded as INFO O1, not a finding.

ui.agentMessages.settings.consent.via_de.verdict: PASS. Short noun phrase for the 'Collected in' grid, symmetric with off_by_default in each locale (Activé par défaut / Activado de forma predeterminada / 默认开启 / Включено по умолчанию / Bật theo mặc định / ڈیفالٹ طور پر فعال / डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से चालू).
